title: Request access to an application
summary: Get added to the access group of an internal application or system, approved by its owner, so that you can sign in with your company account. Also used to create a new access group for a team.

resources.title: Which access group do I need?
resources.description: The groups of every application, with what each one allows.

prerequisites.title: Company account
prerequisites.description: You can sign in to the company portal with single sign-on.

prerequisites.title: Name of the access group
prerequisites.description: Look it up in the list of access groups, e.g. app-billing-readers.

actors.name: Application owner
actors.description: Owner of the application in the service catalogue.

steps.title: Raise the 'Access to an application' request
instructions: Catalogue item: Access to an application.
Choose the access group and say in one sentence what you need it for.
Ask for read access unless you must change data.

steps.title: Approve the access
steps.description: The owner checks that the access fits the person's job and is not more than needed.

steps.title: Ask for a smaller access group
instructions: Read the owner's comment on the request.
Choose the group the owner suggests, usually a read-only one.

steps.title: Add you to the access group
steps.description: The approved request adds you to the group in Entra ID. Access is reviewed every six months and removed when you change team.

steps.title: Sign in to the application
instructions: Sign out of the application and sign in again so the new group is picked up.
Check that you see what you asked for.
If not, reply on the request within 5 days.
